obligation: Form 8-K Item 1.05 material cybersecurity incident disclosure
trigger: The disclosure committee determines the incident is material
deadline: Within 4 business days after the materiality determination; the determination is made without unreasonable delay after discovery. Delay only if the U.S. Attorney General determines disclosure poses a substantial risk to national security or public safety
notifying_entity: Holding company (disclosure committee; Group General Counsel)

obligation: Disclosure committee escalation (internal)
trigger: Severity 1 incident
deadline: Within 24 hours of declaration

obligation: Reg S-K Item 106 annual description
trigger: Any incident that materially affected or is reasonably likely to materially affect the registrant
deadline: Next annual report on Form 10-K

obligation: State breach notice to individuals (Florida worked example)
trigger: Unauthorized access of electronic personal information (for example name with Social Security, passport, or bank account number) of Florida residents
deadline: As expeditiously as practicable and no later than 30 days after determination of the breach or reason to believe a breach occurred; 15 more days only for good cause given in writing to the Department within 30 days (individual notice only)
notify: Each affected Florida resident (workers, growers in credit files, employees), by mail or email
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - payroll, H-2A, and grower credit files
notifying_entity: Each affected subsidiary (Crop Farming as employer; Farm Supply as creditor), coordinated by the Group Chief Privacy Officer
clock_starts: Determination of breach or reason to believe

obligation: State notice to the Department of Legal Affairs (Florida worked example)
trigger: Breach affecting 500 or more individuals in Florida
deadline: No later than 30 days after determination (the 15-day extension does not apply to this notice)
notify: Florida Department of Legal Affairs, with a synopsis, number affected, services offered, a copy of the notice, and a contact
notifying_entity: Each affected subsidiary, coordinated by the Group Chief Privacy Officer

obligation: State notice to consumer reporting agencies (Florida worked example)
trigger: Notice to more than 1,000 individuals at a single time
deadline: Without unreasonable delay
applies_at_this_tier: Yes if more than 1,000 are notified

obligation: No-harm determination (alternative to individual notice; Florida worked example)
trigger: After investigation and consultation with law enforcement, a reasonable determination that the breach will not likely result in identity theft or other financial harm
deadline: Written determination kept 5 years; copy to the Department within 30 days after the determination
applies_at_this_tier: Counsel decides; group policy is not to rely on it when Social Security, passport, or bank account numbers were taken

obligation: Law enforcement delay of individual notice (Florida worked example)
trigger: A law enforcement agency determines in writing that notice would interfere with a criminal investigation
deadline: Delay for the period the agency specifies
notify: Hold individual notices; keep the written request

obligation: Third-party agent notice to the group (inbound; Florida worked example)
trigger: A breach of a system kept by a third-party agent (HR and payroll SaaS, H-2A filing agent, FMIS vendor, card processor)
deadline: Agent must notify the covered entity no later than 10 days after its determination

obligation: Other states' breach laws
citation: Each state where affected individuals reside (7 states of operation plus former workers and growers elsewhere)
trigger: Affected residents of each state
deadline: Varies by state; plan to the shortest applicable deadline
notify: Residents; regulators as each statute requires
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - group operates in 7 southeastern states

obligation: Notice to H-2A workers at home-country addresses (group policy)
citation: POL-03 4.4 (group policy); 20 CFR 655.122(j)(1) requires the permanent home-country address on file
trigger: H-2A worker passport, visa, or pay data taken
deadline: With the first state notices; in Spanish and English
notify: Each affected H-2A worker, by mail and by email or phone where available
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - group policy, not a statute

obligation: H-2A earnings statements during an outage (continuity duty, not a notice)
trigger: Payroll or field tally unavailable
deadline: On or before each payday
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - about 9,000 H-2A workers in season

obligation: H-2A records on DOL request (continuity duty)
trigger: Department of Labor requests earnings records kept at a central office
deadline: Within 72 hours following notice

obligation: Produce Safety records on FDA request (continuity duty)
trigger: FDA requests records while the FMIS or farm links are down
deadline: Readily available; 24 hours for records kept offsite
notifying_entity: Crop Farming Director of Food Safety

obligation: Pesticide application information for treating medical personnel (continuity duty)
trigger: Treating medical personnel request application information for a worker or handler
deadline: Promptly
notifying_entity: Crop Farming Director of Food Safety

obligation: Records access for FDA (Food Processing)
trigger: FDA has a reasonable belief of serious adverse health consequences and issues an official request
deadline: As soon as possible, not to exceed 24 hours from receipt of the request
notifying_entity: Food Processing VP Food Safety and Quality

obligation: Food safety and food defense records for official review (Food Processing)
trigger: FDA requests records; offsite records needed
deadline: Promptly; offsite records within 24 hours; plans remain onsite
notifying_entity: Food Processing VP Food Safety and Quality

obligation: Reportable Food Registry
trigger: The responsible party determines an article of food is a reportable food (for example if tampering with a process control may have adulterated shipped product)
deadline: As soon as practicable, no later than 24 hours after the determination
applies_at_this_tier: Yes for Food Processing (registrant); no for Crop Farming (no registered facility)
notifying_entity: Food Processing VP Food Safety and Quality

obligation: Food Traceability Rule records request
trigger: FDA request to address a threat to public health
deadline: Within 24 hours as an electronic sortable spreadsheet
applies_at_this_tier: No today - FDA will not enforce before 2028-07-20 (Pub. L. 119-37; 91 FR 31723). Tracked

obligation: Buyer notice (Crop Farming)
trigger: Any event that could affect product safety, lot traceability, or committed volumes
deadline: Within 24 hours of becoming aware
notify: Each affected buyer food safety contact
notifying_entity: Crop Farming Director of Food Safety

obligation: Customer notice (Food Processing)
trigger: Event that could affect product safety or supply
deadline: Within 24 hours
notifying_entity: Food Processing security and compliance lead

obligation: Cooperative notice (Farm Supply portal)
trigger: Security incident affecting a reselling cooperative's growers' data
deadline: Within 72 hours
applies_at_this_tier: Yes if portal data is affected
notifying_entity: Farm Supply digital agronomy general manager

obligation: Card brands and acquirer
trigger: Suspected compromise of card data or the card data environment
deadline: Per merchant agreement (immediately on suspicion)
notify: Acquirer, which notifies the card brands
applies_at_this_tier: Only if the card data environment is involved
notifying_entity: Farm Supply security and compliance lead

obligation: Covered telecommunications discovered (Food Processing)
trigger: Covered telecommunications equipment or services identified during contract performance
deadline: Within 1 business day of identification, then within 10 business days with mitigation details
applies_at_this_tier: Yes if found in systems used for USDA contracts
notifying_entity: Food Processing security and compliance lead

obligation: Kaspersky covered article discovered (Food Processing)
trigger: Kaspersky covered article identified during contract performance
deadline: Within 3 business days of identification, then within 10 business days with mitigation details
notifying_entity: Food Processing security and compliance lead

obligation: USDA commodity contract notice
trigger: Delivery delays or events affecting contracted product
deadline: Confirm terms before use (not verified in this sample)

obligation: Ammonia release notice to the National Response Center (Food Processing)
trigger: Release of anhydrous ammonia at or above its reportable quantity (100 lb, 40 CFR 302.4) in any 24-hour period, for example after tampering with refrigeration controls
deadline: Immediately on knowledge of the release

obligation: Emergency release notice to state and local responders (Food Processing)
trigger: Reportable release of an extremely hazardous substance or CERCLA hazardous substance (ammonia)
deadline: Immediate notification, then a written follow-up as soon as practicable
notify: Community emergency coordinator for the local emergency planning committee and the state emergency response commission

obligation: CIRCIA covered cyber incident and ransom payment reports
trigger: Covered cyber incident; ransom payment
deadline: Proposed: 72 hours; 24 hours after a ransom payment
applies_at_this_tier: No - final rule not published as of 2026-09-25; not in effect

obligation: OFAC sanctions check before any ransom payment
trigger: A ransom payment is considered
deadline: Before any payment; full and timely reporting to law enforcement or CISA is a mitigating factor
notify: OFAC (license if a sanctioned party is involved); FBI or CISA

obligation: Voluntary report to law enforcement and CISA
citation: FBI field office or IC3; CISA reporting
trigger: Ransomware or extortion
deadline: As soon as practical (Day 0 to 1)
applies_at_this_tier: Voluntary; supports investigation and OFAC mitigation

obligation: Cyber insurance claim notice
trigger: Suspected security incident
deadline: Per policy; use the insurer panel before hiring vendors

obligation: FMIS vendor incident notice (inbound)
trigger: Security incident at the FMIS vendor affecting group data
deadline: Per contract (72 hours)
notify: Crop Farming security and compliance lead

obligation: Integrator incident notice (inbound, from the new security schedule)
trigger: Security incident at the integrator or involving its access
deadline: Within 24 hours (once the schedule is signed; due 2026-12-31)
